_about: The FIELD LAYER's words and its SELECTOR ties (D-024). The lab's renderers tag what they draw in their own code (window.DRAWN); this file holds only (1) the words the section map's field marks, status line, kept-outline bar and rail options say, and (2) the ties a renderer cannot say — a selector per attribute, applied to what one region drew. Every tie, in the code or here, is the agent's proposal: the ids are typed by hand in both places. A tie here is marked on its field's hover card, and on the face (dashed) only when the rail's proposals option says so, because how the map knows is behind "more information" by D-017. Read by _ep_fieldlayer.py, which refuses an id the inventory does not have, a region the lab does not have, or a tie with no reason. A {token} is filled by the page from what it measured; no number is typed here.
